summary: On 2026-08-19 Moderna/Merck said the intismeran (personalized mRNA) melanoma vaccine plus Keytruda met its Phase 3 primary endpoint; stock rose 177%. On 2026-09-21 the data got an ESMO Presidential Symposium slot for Oct 24; shares rose 12% and kept climbing.
support_reason: First positive Phase 3 mRNA cancer-vaccine readout is real, but no efficacy numbers yet; rally prices in the conclusion ahead of ESMO.
dilution_or_offering: none found (no S-3/424B filings since July; only Form 4s and 8-Ks)
